name: Learn Japanese To Survive! Katakana War
source:
Learn Japanese To Survive! Katakana War is an educational game that is the ideal introductory course to the Japanese language! It's the sequel to the smash-hit Hiragana Battle – but you don't need to have played that!

This new game teaches you a separate part of Japanese: the Katakana writing system.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/554600/Learn_Japanese_To_Survive_Katakana_War/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
学习日语才能生存！片假名大战是一款教育游戏，是理想的日语入门课程！这是风靡一时的平假名大战的续作 - 但你不需要玩过它！

这个新游戏教你日语的一个单独部分：片假名书写系统。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/554600/Learn_Japanese_To_Survive_Katakana_War/]Steam[/url]]
